content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Vacancy Details (Post-wise)
content_sections.text: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support Staff III post under the ICMR project.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: Graduate in Science/relevant subjects from a recognized university with five years' work experience from a recognized institution. OR Master's degree in relevant subject (Psychology/Social work/Sociology). Desirable: Previous experience of working in community projects and proficiency in Hindi and English language.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for candidates applying for the Project Technical Support Staff III post is 35 Years .

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Salary
content_sections.text: The position is purely on a temporary basis, co-terminus with the project.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process comprises a Screening or Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants, followed by a Walk-In-Interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment
content_sections.text: Download the official notification PDF and application format from the website. Fill out the application form with correct details. Prepare your bio-data along with self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience. Gather all relevant original documents and a passport-size photo. Report in person at the venue on 15 October 2026 at 9:00 AM for the walk-in interview. Interview Venue: Department of Community Medicine and Family Medicine, Second Floor, Medical College Building, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur Basni, Phase 2nd, Jodhpur - 342005

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Filled application form Bio-data Original documents for verification Self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications, and relevant experience Passport size photo No Objection Certificate (for candidates working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking)

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Reporting time for candidates is 9:00 AM on 15 October 2026, and the closing time to report for interview is 10:00 AM. No additional candidates will be entertained after the closing time. The posts are filled-up on a purely temporary basis, co-terminus with the project. Candidates will have no right to claim for permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur. No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview, including SC/ST candidates. All educational professional and technical qualifications should be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. All essential qualifications and experience certificates are required to be enclosed with the application form.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Jodhpur (AIIMS Jodhpur) is conducting this recruitment for an ICMR research project.

faq.question: Q2. What post is being recruited under AIIMS Jodhpur Notification 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Jodhpur is recruiting for Project Technical Support Staff III posts under an ICMR Extramural Research Study.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 2 vacancies are available for the Project Technical Support Staff III post.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in interview date for AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 15 October 2026, with reporting time from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for Project Technical Support Staff III?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduate degree in Science or relevant subjects with five years of experience, or a Master's degree in Psychology, Social work, or Sociology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is 35 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary provided for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 28,000 plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Jodhpur walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The interview will be held at the Department of Community Medicine and Family Medicine, Second Floor, Medical College Building, AIIMS Jodhpur.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job under AIIMS Jodhpur?
faq.answer: No, these positions are purely temporary and co-terminus with the ICMR project, offering no right to permanent employment.
